title: Basically Gyrokinetic Wand
description: Adds the Gyrokinetic Wand from Hypixel Skyblock into an item
body:
# GYROKINETIC WAND

## What's this mod about?

Well, it adds a **wand, that teleports the mobs around you to the block you right click** (10 block radius)

## Isn't this too overpowered?

No, actually you need to **break a lot of crying obsidian** and **get 4 netherite blocks**

## Wait what do you mean crying obsidian?

**Well, to get the ingredient (Location Core) you need to break crying obsidian,** which has a **10% chance to drop a core**,

## NOTES:
**Made in _MCreator_**
_Probably the final release_
